title: eludite.editor.toggle_outlining_expansion input
description: Toggle Outlining Expansion (Edit > Outlining, Ctrl+M, Ctrl+M): collapse the innermost region at the caret, or expand it when it is collapsed.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line whose innermost region toggles instead of the caret's (a collapsed region's header line toggles that region).
